name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Wee.wee_identity
title: Wee's identity: the succinct-LWE trapdoor puts attributes in BGG+ form
statement: If B T_B[i,j] + W_i T_W[j] = delta_ij G for all blocks i, j (the trapdoor [I (x) B | W] T = I (x) G of l-succinct LWE, block by block), then for every attribute vector w and matrix R, A := sum_i w_i W_i + B R satisfies A T_W[j] = B (R T_W[j] - sum_i w_i T_B[i,j]) + w_j G. Algebraic step of the leaf lemma of the witness-tree WE candidate.
